claim: A genuine native room conversation can start a grant-owned generated beat, return a reply, then attach/detach exact phone lights or change tempo in later turns using the same conversation.

contract.lifetime: Captured exact guest lease/controller generation/thread/room/epoch survives native-turn finish, ends on replacement/revoke/expiry/reset.
contract.phase: Generated file uses absolute sample-grid beat boundaries; backend uses mapped afplay process-launch timestamp and monotonic grid.
contract.tempo_update: Stops owned previous loop and confirms cleanup, then starts a new loop with a new phase; no seamless tempo-warp claim.
contract.phone_pulse: ON at future beat boundary, OFF at one quarter of period. Unsent stale ON is skipped, never caught up. Sent UNKNOWN stops future program steps.
contract.ownership: No job/step count cap. A boolean phone output follows one clock; actionable conflict→confirmed detach→ordinary action preserves music. UNKNOWN cleanup remains reserved until exact quiescent host-reset OFF receipt.
contract.preparation: beat.prepare renders no playback; beat.start separately rechecks current native authority after render.
contract.speech_overlap: An unsent queued status read is congestion, not audio failure. Owned stop queue budget must include accepted speech budget plus normal stop allowance.
contract.truth: Process launch/ACK/dispatch are not physical audibility or optical synchronization.

checks.independent_reviewer: room_programs_review; no remaining blocking source defect after fixes
review_regressions: Tempo restart cannot steal/release another logical device lock.
Detach and access-ended cleanup coalesce and preserve confirmed outcomes.
Aborted tempo restart releases known-clean reservations.
Blocked WAV preparation never blocks another owned audio stop.
other_cases: Exact owner and current-turn checks before prepare/start/update/stop.
Native turn completion does not stop the beat; later same-guest phone attach follows the same clock.
Quarter-pulse late join, clock jumps/no backlog, nonbinary100BPM grid, and no cumulative WAV rounding drift.
Queued revoke sends no later ON; no connection migration/substitution.
UNKNOWN never replays; phone reservation and explicit host-reset receipt recovery.
Long accepted speech does not falsely stop the beat; stop has derived queue budget.
Cancelled quiescence settles shielded output cleanup, preventing late queued commands.
Explicit speech suppresses auto narration; actual rendered AIFF duration is checked before speech playback.

actual_offline_asset_measurement.uncertainty: One local render timing, not a performance distribution or live audio result.

remaining: Core owner must wire audio_queue_timeout and quiesce/close budget to native speech cleanup bound plus normal stop allowance, then run final combined suite.
Coordinator must commit/deploy reviewed Brain+audio bridge and verify ordinary automatic speech; do not replay prior UNKNOWN.

Generated beat audibility and 20-beat audio/phone video test remain unperformed. Proposed feasibility screen: zero extra/missing matches, max absolute signed onset skew<=100ms and drift<=100ms. Failing/unmeasured synchronization must remain labeled approximate.
owen_feature_request_if_physical_screen_: Optional phone-local scheduled pattern with program ID, phase/tempo, expiry and keyed cancellation, truthful scheduled ACK and no catch-up/replay; current boolean bridge remains approximate. No web implementation done.
limits: Prepared Music playlist has no BPM metadata and is not synchronized by this engine.
Clock mapping assumes the current same-host Mac setup; cross-host clock alignment and physical output latency are unmeasured.
Generic native OS shell effects are outside the enrolled-device Bus lifecycle guarantees.
